limitations: Auditor author also authored controllers; audit-test author also authored world. This is independent code from world/evaluator/runner, not independent-human or external replication.
Source admission and provider guarantees are application assumptions; logs and persisted schedule consistency cannot establish authentication or rule out off-record external calls.
Finite safety cutoff does not establish absence of arbitrarily late effects.
Missing failed-slot snapshots remain failures and cannot receive a lifecycle audit.
Recorded elapsed wall times are checked for shape only, not independently remeasured.
